title: About Us: AI Product Photos and Video Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into store images and AI video ads in minutes, with no studio, no casting and private uploads. See how it works.
h1: About AIVideosUGC: Product Visuals Made Simple
lead: AIVideosUGC helps small online shops make product photos and short AI video ads from a single product photo, so a new ad takes minutes instead of a shoot.
secondary_keywords: product content tool for Etsy shops

paras: Upload a picture of what you sell, pick a template or write the scene you want, and get back a square store image or a short AI video ad of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

Every tool does a job sellers do every week: white background shots, lifestyle scenes, on-model photos, feed ad images and vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. No design software, no ad agency and no studio day.
It is built for small and growing stores on Shopify, Amazon and Etsy, and for the marketers who run their ads. If you pack orders, write listings and set up campaigns yourself, this is for you.

You don't need editing skills. A clear photo of your product and a sentence about the scene you picture are enough to start, and you can make a fresh version of an ad whenever a hook or an offer needs testing.
Everything you upload and everything you make stays in your own account. Your product photos and results are never shown to other customers or made public.
Some requests are turned down, such as ones involving celebrities or other public figures, or logos and trademarks that belong to someone else. That keeps every ad focused on your own products.
Every photo and video shows its price in credits before the job starts, so nothing spends without your say-so. Plans run from $24.50 a month with 200 credits.

Credits are held while a job runs and used only when the result arrives. Delivered results are generally not refunded, which is why the cost is always on screen before you commit; if a job fails, the credits go back to your balance automatically.

faq.q: Can I make product ads without hiring an agency?
faq.a: Yes. AIVideosUGC is self-serve: upload your product photo or describe the scene, review the result, and download the asset from your account. There is no booking, no shoot day and no waiting on an editor.

faq.q: How do I get in touch with the AIVideosUGC team?
faq.a: Write to support@aivideosugc.com with your question. Email is the best way to reach the team.

faq.q: What can I upload to make a product asset?
faq.a: Upload a product photo for an image. For a video, you can upload a photo or describe the product and scene. Compare the result with the real item before you download or publish it.
For online sellers and marketers who need product photos and short ad videos from their own product images or descriptions, without hiring a studio or an agency.
Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits, and each photo or video shows its credit cost before the job starts. If a job fails, its credits come back automatically.

faq.q: Do you keep a model I can reuse?
faq.a: No. Your uploads and results stay in your account, and each new asset starts from the product reference you provide.

ctaLead: Pick a photo or video tool, see the cost before you start, and make a store asset for your next listing or ad.
